editorial.blurb: Pho No.1 Brewing Co. serves deeply satisfying Vietnamese pho with premium beef cuts and exceptional broth, anchored by genuine hospitality in a modern, brewery-inspired space.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the pho with their signature beef assortment (like the combination bowl) and arrive around 5:30 PM on a weekday for quick seating and immediate service—the broth is consistently praised as the star.

topDishes.note: Fantastic broth and fabulous—reviewers rave about the rich, two-day simmered stock
Delicious assortment of premium meats in great-tasting broth, worth the price
Fresh and uniquely wrapped with plenty of lettuce, a different take on the classic
